question: One Astronomical Unit and one Parsec are units of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**"Length"**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The distance** from** Earth **to** the sun** is called an** astronomical unit**, or** AU,** which is used to** measure distances** throughout the** solar system**.It is equal to **149.6 million kilometres**, the mean distance from the** centre of the earth** to the **centre of the sun**.
 
• 
 **Parsec** is a unit of** length** used to measure large** distances** to objects outside **the Solar System**.**One parsec** is the distance at which one **astronomical unit** **subtends an angle **of **one arc second**. **A parsec** is equal to about **3.26** light-years (**31 trillion km or 19 trillion miles)** in **length**.​
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Current** is the** rate** at which** electrons flow** past a** point** in a **complete electrical circuit**. At its most basic, **current = flow**.The unit of **electric current** is** ampere**.
 
• **Mass** is a **dimensionless quantity** representing the **amount of matter** in a** particle** or **object**. **The standard unit of mass** in the **International System (SI)** is the **kilogram (kg).**
 
• **Volume **is defined as the space occupied within the** boundaries of an object **in **three-dimensional space**. It is also known as the** capacity of the object**.
